headline: Ganesh Benzoplast files AGM voting results and scrutinizer report
hook: Scrutinizer report submitted for Ganesh Benzoplast
summary: Ganesh Benzoplast Limited has submitted the scrutinizer report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. Routine filing of shareholder resolutions and voting outcomes. For Indian retail investors, this is standard corporate governance compliance with no immediate material financial impact.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance update with no financial impact on shareholders.
